days.title: Central Architecture and Islands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kapuziner Island
stops.detail: Prehistoric pile dwellings and artefacts dating from the 4th millennium BC have been discovered in the area around Kapuziner Island.

stops.name: Maria Wörth
stops.detail: The church island of Maria Wörth is one of the most famous spots on Lake Wörthersee – with lake views, a wedding chapel and peaceful paths along the peninsula.

stops.name: Pörtschach am Wörthersee
stops.detail: With 2 km of lakeside promenade, magnificent villas and historic charm, Pörtschach am Wörthersee is characterised by its lakeside setting and spa architecture.

stops.name: Promenadenbad Pörtschach
stops.detail: Numerous lidos line the shores of Lake Wörthersee, including Klagenfurt Lido , Promenadenbad Pörtschach and Velden Lido .

days.title: Western Shore and Viewpoints
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Pyramidenkogel observation tower
stops.detail: Around the lake, promenades lead to cafés, lakeside terraces and bathing spots, while attractions such as the Pyramidenkogel observation tower, Minimundus and cruises on Lake Wörthersee can easily be combined with a day by the water.

stops.name: Velden
stops.detail: Boutique hotels, lakeside terraces, and bars are a defining feature of Velden's townscape – particularly during the summer months along the lakeside promenade.
